0d422ec8a01684c279deb857.mathml: <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>T</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>′</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>q</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>′</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mi>α</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>′</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T(x,x')=q(x,x')\alpha(x,x')</annotation></semantics></math>

115394dfa1448588b2fe452c.mathml: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>∂</mi><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow><mrow><mi>∂</mi><msub><mi>θ</mi><mi>k</mi></msub></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mi>P</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo minsize="1.2" maxsize="1.2" stretchy="false" form="prefix">(</mo><msub><mover><mi>e</mi><mo accent="true">̂</mo></mover><mi>k</mi></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>𝔼</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">[</mo><msub><mover><mi>e</mi><mo accent="true">̂</mo></mover><mi>k</mi></msub><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">]</mo></mrow><mo minsize="1.2" maxsize="1.2" stretchy="false" form="postfix">)</mo><mi>.</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\partial P(x)}{\partial\theta_k}=-P(x)\bigl(\hat e_k(x)-\mathbb E[\hat e_k]\bigr).</annotation></semantics></math>

79d86dc7fec4f7acc75936b7.mathml: <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>∂</mi><mi>𝔼</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">[</mo><msub><mover><mi>e</mi><mo accent="true">̂</mo></mover><mi>j</mi></msub><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">]</mo></mrow><mi>/</mi><mi>∂</mi><msub><mi>θ</mi><mi>k</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mo>Cov</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><msub><mover><mi>e</mi><mo accent="true">̂</mo></mover><mi>j</mi></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mover><mi>e</mi><mo accent="true">̂</mo></mover><mi>k</mi></msub><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\partial\mathbb E[\hat e_j]/\partial\theta_k=-\operatorname{Cov}(\hat e_j,\hat e_k)</annotation></semantics></math>
